items.title: Migrating Epic to AWS returned 185% over three years compared to on-premises deployments
items.summary: A Forrester Total Economic Impact study commissioned by AWS found that migrating Epic EHR environments to AWS returned 185% over three years, with full payback in under six months, lower latency and faster load times for clinicians, and $4.5 million in clinician-efficiency savings.
items.creator: Matt Dinger

items.title: Smart paint shop: How agentic AI turns quality anomalies into scheduling decisions
items.summary: SPARK is an agentic AI system that detects quality anomalies in an automotive paint shop and responds automatically. It classifies the anomaly, reschedules production around the affected tank, and generates a root cause analysis report with fixes, while operators review each incident before maintenance acts.
items.creator: Sridhar Mahadevan
